procedure_text: 将40g  2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(99.7％、0.152mol)，200ml二氯甲烷，0.5g偶氮二异丁腈(99％、0.003mol)，34g氢溴酸(48％、0.202mol)加入500ml反应瓶中，在45～50℃滴加25g双氧水(30％、0.22mol)，滴加完毕后继续反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后分层，有机层水洗、浓缩，乙醇进行重结晶、过滤、烘干得46g白色粉末，纯度99.8％，收率88.5％。
procedure_summary: The benzylic methyl group of the benzoate ester is brominated with hydrobromic acid and aqueous hydrogen peroxide in dichloromethane, using azobisisobutyronitrile as the radical initiator, the peroxide being added dropwise at controlled temperature and the mixture followed by liquid chromatography to complete conversion. The layers are then separated, the organic layer washed with water and concentrated, and the product recrystallised from ethanol, filtered and oven dried to a white powder.
notes: Chinese heading 1、2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的合成 (synthesis of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate). Reactor is a 500 ml 反应瓶, a plain reaction flask; no stirrer, thermometer or condenser is itemised anywhere in this section, so stirring.type is left null and reactor_type carries no four-necked designation. TEMPERATURE: the only number stated is the 45 to 50 C at which the hydrogen peroxide is added dropwise; after the addition the text says only 滴加完毕后继续反应 (the reaction is continued) with no further temperature, so the stated range is recorded and nothing is carried past it. TIME: no reaction time is given in this step or anywhere in this section; every step is run to LC completion instead, so time_h is null throughout and that is a property of the document rather than a gap in the reading. NAMED REACTION: none is recorded. This is a radical benzylic bromination but it uses hydrobromic acid with hydrogen peroxide as the in-situ oxidant and azobisisobutyronitrile as initiator, not N-bromosuccinimide, so Wohl-Ziegler does not fit and no name is stretched onto it. SOLUTION STRENGTHS: the 48 percent on the hydrobromic acid and the 30 percent on the hydrogen peroxide sit in the same parenthesised slot as the 99 percent purity figures of the other charges but are the strengths of aqueous solutions, and both mass and mole pairs confirm that reading. Because two reagents carry a strength and conditions.concentration holds only one, that field is left null and the strengths are carried on the compound records as A1 recorded them. ARITHMETIC, ALL CLOSES: substrate 40 g at 99.7 percent is 0.1518 mol against the printed 0.152; azobisisobutyronitrile 0.5 g at 99 percent is 0.00301 mol against 0.003; hydrobromic acid 34 g at 48 percent is 0.2017 mol of HBr against 0.202; hydrogen peroxide 25 g at 30 percent is 0.2205 mol against 0.22. Product closure: 0.1518 mol at the product molecular weight of 341.60 gives 51.86 g theoretical, and the printed 46 g at the printed 99.8 percent purity is 45.91 g, which is 88.5 percent of theory against the printed 88.5 percent. The yield in this section is computed on an assay-corrected basis at both ends, and on that basis it closes exactly. No mass_balance_implausible and no molar_mass_inconsistent are raised. DRAWING: the single-structure span before this step, SMILES COC(=O)c1ccc(S(C)(=O)=O)c(CBr)c1Cl, formula C10H10BrClO4S, is the product named in the heading. Drawing and prose agree, so no drawing_text_conflict. CONDITIONS DIFFER FROM EXAMPLE 1 of this patent, which runs the same transformation in a different solvent and at a different temperature; nothing has been carried across from that section and every value here is read from this section's own text.

procedure_text: 将35g  2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(99.8％、0.102mol)，21.41g碳酸钾(99％、0.153mol)，1g三乙烯二胺(99％、0.008mol)，200ml  DMF，15.46g2,2,2-三氟乙醇(99％、0.153mol)加入500ml反应瓶中，在70～75℃进行反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完毕后过滤，滤液浓缩。往剩余物里4.53g氢氧化钠(99％、0.112mol)，200ml水，在70～75℃进行碱解，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后滴加盐酸酸化，过滤，洗涤，烘干得31.82g白色粉末，纯度99.8％，收率89.6％。
procedure_summary: The benzylic bromide is etherified with trifluoroethanol over potassium carbonate with a diamine catalyst in dimethylformamide until liquid chromatography shows complete conversion. The salts are filtered off and the filtrate concentrated, and the residue is hydrolysed without isolation using sodium hydroxide in water at the same temperature. The hydrolysate is acidified dropwise with hydrochloric acid and the precipitated acid filtered, washed and oven dried to a white powder.
notes: Chinese heading 2、2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的合成. ONE POT, CONFIRMED FROM THIS SECTION'S OWN TEXT: one numbered step, two sequential transformations in the same vessel. The etherification is run to LC completion, the mixture is then filtered and the filtrate concentrated, and the sodium hydroxide and water are charged 往剩余物里 (into the residue). The filtration removes the inorganic salts and the concentration removes the solvent; the ether intermediate is never named, never assigned an amount and never purified, so the two transformations are kept as one record. reaction_class follows the FINAL transformation and is therefore hydrolysis; named_reaction records Williamson ether synthesis, which names the first transformation, because the saponification carries no canonical name. THE ACIDIFICATION IS NOT COUNTED AS A THIRD TRANSFORMATION: converting the sodium carboxylate back to the free acid with hydrochloric acid is the isolation operation for this product, and it is recorded in workup and in ph_target_stage rather than in one_pot_steps. NO INTERMEDIATE COMPOUND IS EMITTED for the ether formed in the flask: unlike some other sections of this document the text here names it not at all, calling it only 剩余物 (the residue), so emitting a named intermediate would be inventing one. CONDITIONS: both transformations are run at 70 to 75 C, so the single recorded range is not a choice between two different stated values. No time is stated for either transformation; both are run to LC completion. No heating method is named, and 碱解 is alkaline hydrolysis, a transformation, not a temperature or a heating method. Reactor is a 500 ml 反应瓶. THE ONE ARITHMETIC DEFECT IN THIS SECTION IS HERE. molar_mass_inconsistent on the triethylenediamine charge, printed 1g三乙烯二胺(99％、0.008mol). Triethylenediamine is 1,4-diazabicyclo[2.2.2]octane, C6H12N2, molecular weight 112.18. 1 g at 99 percent is 0.99 g, which is 0.00883 mol, not 0.008 mol; the printed mole figure is 9.4 percent below the mass it is paired with, and it does not round to 0.008 at the three decimal places the section prints, it truncates to it. Read the other way, 1 g against 0.008 mol implies a molecular weight of 125.00 gross, or 123.75 after the 99 percent, against the true 112.18, an over-statement of 10.3 percent. For the printed 0.008 mol the charge would have to be 0.91 g gross, so neither figure repairs the other cleanly and both are recorded exactly as printed. This is not a rounding artefact of small numbers: every other sub-gram charge in this section closes, azobisisobutyronitrile at 0.5 g and 0.003 mol to within 0.5 percent, N,N-dimethylformamide at 0.3 g and 0.004 mol to within 1.6 percent and acetone cyanohydrin at 1 g and 0.011 mol to within 1.5 percent, and 1,3-cyclohexanedione in step 3 has a molecular weight of 112.13, within 0.05 of triethylenediamine's, and its 14.6 g and 0.129 mol pair closes to within 0.1 percent. EVERY OTHER NUMBER IN THIS STEP CLOSES: substrate 35 g at 99.8 percent is 0.10225 mol against the printed 0.102; potassium carbonate 21.41 g at 99 percent is 0.15337 mol against 0.153; trifluoroethanol 15.46 g at 99 percent is 0.15299 mol against 0.153; sodium hydroxide 4.53 g at 99 percent is 0.11213 mol against 0.112. Product closure: 0.10225 mol at the product molecular weight of 346.70 gives 35.45 g theoretical, and the printed 31.82 g at the printed 99.8 percent purity is 31.76 g, which is 89.6 percent of theory against the printed 89.6 percent, so mass_balance_implausible is not raised. scale_discontinuity is NOT raised: this step charges 35 g of a material of which step 1 isolated 46 g, which is a subset and therefore possible. DRAWING: the single-structure span before this step, SMILES CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)O)c(Cl)c1COCC(F)(F)F, formula C11H10ClF3O5S, is the free acid named in the heading and not the methyl ester, which independently corroborates that the hydrolysis belongs inside this step. Drawing and prose agree, so no drawing_text_conflict.

procedure_text: 将30g  2-氯-3- (2 ,2 ,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸(99 .8％、0.086mol)，0.3g  DMF(99％、0.004mol)，12.4g氯化亚砜(99％、0.103mol)，100ml二氯乙烷加入250ml反应瓶中，升温回流反应，反应完毕后脱尽溶剂。将14.6g  1,3-环己二酮(99％、0.129mol)、100ml二氯甲烷加入反应瓶，在20～25℃滴加21.97g三乙胺(99％、0.215mol)，LC跟踪至反应完全。反应完全后，加入1g丙酮氰醇(95％、0.011mol)，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后加入水进行水洗，分层，油层脱尽溶剂，加乙醇进行重结晶，过滤，烘干得32.63g米黄色结晶粉末，纯度98.1％，收率84.1％。
procedure_summary: The benzoic acid is converted to its acid chloride with thionyl chloride and catalytic dimethylformamide at reflux and the solvent stripped off. Cyclohexanedione and dichloromethane are charged to the same flask, triethylamine is added dropwise under mild cooling until liquid chromatography shows complete acylation, and acetone cyanohydrin is then added to carry the acylation product on to the rearranged dione. A water wash, phase separation, removal of the solvent and recrystallisation from ethanol give the herbicide as a beige crystalline powder.
notes: Chinese heading 3、环磺酮的合成 (synthesis of tembotrione), the final step of the section. ONE POT, CONFIRMED FROM THIS SECTION'S OWN TEXT: one numbered step, three sequential transformations in the same vessel. The acid chloride is formed at reflux and the solvent stripped off completely (脱尽溶剂), with no aqueous workup and no isolation, and the acid chloride is never named or assigned an amount. The dione and dichloromethane are then charged 加入反应瓶, into the same reaction flask, and triethylamine added dropwise. When LC shows that acylation complete, acetone cyanohydrin is added directly to the same mixture and the reaction followed again to completion. There is no workup between any pair of transformations, so all three are kept as one record. reaction_class follows the FINAL transformation. That transformation is the acetone cyanohydrin promoted migration of the aroyl group from the enol oxygen to C2 of the dione, an isomerisation; the closed class list has no rearrangement value, so acylation is recorded with medium confidence and the rearrangement character is carried in tags as transformation:rearrangement. named_reaction is null: no widely accepted name covers a thionyl chloride activation followed by enol acylation and a cyanohydrin promoted acyl migration, and stretching for one would be wrong. CONDITIONS: the only number stated in the whole step is the 20 to 25 C of the triethylamine addition, which is the value recorded. 升温回流反应 gives no temperature, so reflux is recorded as heating_method and not as a temperature, and it belongs to the first transformation. No time is stated for any of the three transformations; all are run to LC completion. Reactor is a 250 ml 反应瓶, the smallest in the section. TWO CHLORINATED SOLVENTS, KEPT APART: the first stage charges 100 ml 二氯乙烷 and the second 100 ml 二氯甲烷. The text spells them differently and A1 holds them as separate records, the first unresolved because no locant is printed; they are not merged here. ARITHMETIC, ALL CLOSES: substrate 30 g at 99.8 percent is 0.08636 mol against the printed 0.086; N,N-dimethylformamide 0.3 g at 99 percent is 0.00406 mol against 0.004; thionyl chloride 12.4 g at 99 percent is 0.10319 mol against 0.103; 1,3-cyclohexanedione 14.6 g at 99 percent is 0.12891 mol against 0.129; triethylamine 21.97 g at 99 percent is 0.21494 mol against 0.215; acetone cyanohydrin 1 g at 95 percent is 0.01116 mol against 0.011. Product closure: 0.08636 mol at the product molecular weight of 440.82 gives 38.07 g theoretical, and the printed 32.63 g at the printed 98.1 percent purity is 32.01 g, which is 84.1 percent of theory against the printed 84.1 percent. On the gross mass alone it would read 85.7 percent, so the assay correction is what makes it close, and it closes on that basis in all three steps of this section. No mass_balance_implausible and no molar_mass_inconsistent are raised. scale_discontinuity is NOT raised: this step charges 30 g of a material of which step 2 isolated 31.82 g, which is a subset and therefore possible. DRAWING: the single-structure span before this step, SMILES CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)C2C(=O)CCCC2=O)c(Cl)c1COCC(F)(F)F, formula C17H16ClF3O6S, is the C-acylated cyclohexane-1,3-dione, that is the rearranged product and not the O-acyl enol ester. Drawing and prose agree, so no drawing_text_conflict, and the drawing is direct corroboration that the third transformation belongs inside this step. SAFETY: acetone cyanohydrin is charged and the safety tag records that, but the text states no safety instruction of any kind, so safety_notes is left empty rather than filled with an assessment of my own.
